correctness.rationale: For n>=4, Walsh degree<=2 inner-product isometry under a measure uniform in each of three complete Hamming shells is equivalent to the binomial coordinate sum S matching moments of degrees 1..4. Moment values (0,n,0,3n²-2n), cubic Q(S) orthogonal to 1,S, and division of degree<=4 polynomials by Q yield exactly ab+ac+bc=-(3n-2) and abc=-n(a+b+c). The quadratic Lagrange cardinal polynomials give unique weights, each strictly positive by E_mu[L_j(S)^2]>0 since full binomial support has n+1>=5 atoms; rank3 moment Gram forbids at most two support shells. The u=b+c discriminant formula is necessary/sufficient for every integer first-node candidate a; a²=n cannot occur for n>=4. Direct algebra verifies pole, symmetric and nonpolar families, and Pell invariance from (s,r)=(14,8). Independent integer enumerations through n=250 (54 valid triples), independent two-node algorithm through n=125, and rational moment tests agree; finite exhaustive loop proves first multiple inversion-orbit dimension 65 after algebraic completeness of the enumerator, while Pell induction proves infinitely many coexistence dimensions.
